//: How ts-jest compiles the tests. NestJS 12 ships ES modules only, and jest can only require one of those on Node 24.9 and up; emitting the tests as ES modules instead makes them load the framework the normal way, on any Node 24. The app itself still builds as CommonJS, which is what `nest build` and the official template do.
//rootDir: Every test is under `src`. Saying so is what keeps ts-jest from guessing a different root per directory (TS5011), now that `tsconfig.json` leaves `rootDir` to whoever emits.
